hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Guide shoe and float shoe
function: The rounded fitting at the bottom of each string that guides it past ledges and, as a float shoe, carries a check valve that keeps cement from flowing back up the casing.

tabs.overview: Drillable body; the check valve holds the cement column until it sets; the shoe track between the float collar and the shoe is left full of cement.
tabs.engineering: Drillable materials; ratings per the string.
tabs.safety: Float failure shows as cement flowing back when the pumps stop.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
